originalTitle: The MSI Claw EX is the most important PC handheld since Steam Deck — I still wouldn’t buy one

content: As The Verge’s resident handheld reviewer, I have nearly every portable gaming PC on a shelf in my house. The MSI Claw 8 EX AI Plus is now the first one I reach for. Thanks to a next-gen Intel chip and improved MSI design, the Claw EX is the most powerful handheld that truly feels portable. It’s the handheld with the longest battery life, and the first Windows handheld I can trust to sleep and wake reliably.  Like the Steam Deck, when I press the power button, my game is always right where I left off. Unlike the Steam Deck, it can hibernate for days without losing a significant amount of charge.  Performance and battery? Windows and sleep? I wish I could say “you can have your cake and eat it too.” But you can’t. You probably shouldn’t. You can’t because this is a Ferris Bueller Product Review — this handheld costs a staggering $1,800, and you’ll be lucky to find it even at that price. (MSI’s Anne Lee tells me the US should have limited supply sometime this month.) Even if you could, you probably shouldn’t because Intel and MSI and Microsoft didn’t fully stick the landing. This is indeed a milestone for the handheld gaming space. But like actual milestones on a highway, you should probably drive right past. [Product: MSI Claw 8 EX AI Plus | https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fclaw-8-ex-ai-cg3em-8-120hz-fhd-1200p-gaming-handheld-intel-arc-g3-extreme-intel-arc-32gb-1tbssd-console%2FJ3P7TXTKW3, https://go.skimresources.com/?id=1025X1701640&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bhphotovideo.com%2Fc%2Fproduct%2F1972338-REG%2Fmsi_claw_8_ex_ai_cg3em_024us_claw_8_ai_cg3em.html, https://click.linksynergy.com/deeplink?id=nOD/rLJHOac&mid=44583&murl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newegg.com%2Fp%2FN82E16868969012%3Fitem%3DN82E16868969012] The Claw EX does have comfortable grips, I’ll give it that. Those manta-ray-wings wonderfully spread out its weight, to the point that the 1.73-pound (785g) portable feels far more comfortable than the 1.58-pound (715g) Xbox Ally X when I hold it above me in bed. And while a $1,800 handheld should really have an amazing OLED screen, I definitely prefer the Claw EX’s 8-inch 1920 x 1200 48-120Hz VRR screen to the comparatively cramped 7-inch 1080p one in the Allys. The only real problem is glare — the ultra-glossy screen was not great on my road trip this summer. But the controls are merely average, the fan is loud (though it’s whoosh not whine), and those manta-ray grips can buzz my hands when I turn up the speakers. Sound reverberates inside. [Image: I love the grips. Buttons are fine. The joysticks are drift-resistant magnetic ones, but really need tuning. I undershoot and overshoot too much. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/verge-msi-claw-ex-sean-hollister-1-2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: Here’s the underside of those meaty grips. I’d prefer grippier, but the stippling is not bad at all. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/verge-msi-claw-ex-sean-hollister-1-6_a1af8c.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] No, the Claw EX’s true strengths are performance and battery — but even there, the handheld sometimes let me down. I’ve always loved the phrase “potato graphics.” It’s such a fun way to describe what games look like when your rig is too weak. They’re rough and pasty — like a potato! — even when running smoothly. Or if you turn up the graphics anyway, you get a “slideshow” because your hardware can’t deliver enough frames. The first reason I reach for the Claw EX, before any other handheld, is because I don’t automatically get potatoes or slideshow when I fire up demanding PC games. Like my colleague Jay Peters showed you on launch day, the Claw EX makes games look so much sharper than they do on a Steam Deck, and it’s not just the Deck that’s getting beat. The Xbox Ally X with its AMD Z2 Extreme chip, and the old MSI Claw 8 with Intel Lunar Lake, aren’t playing demanding games smoothly at the 1080p or 1200p resolution of their screens. The Claw EX often can, and I’m seeing around 40 percent more performance than the Xbox Ally X in my tests at 1080p. In many games, like Forza Horizon 6 and Cyberpunk 2077, that’s the difference between playing at native resolution or settling for less. [Table: 1080p benchmarks] When I add a little upscaling, I can even start enjoying games I haven’t been able to enjoy handheld because of potato graphics. I could swing lightsabers in Star Wars Jedi: Survivor and crack whips in Indiana Jones and the Great Circle at good quality with smooth frame rate while binging K-dramas with my spouse. Until, suddenly, I couldn’t — seemingly because Intel’s drivers aren’t playing nice with some games yet. When my Indy visited the Great Pyramid, the Intel chip would simply not run at the wattage I set, and I found spots where the entire game would repeatedly freeze or even trigger a full system hang. In Jedi: Survivor, the game is weirdly stuttery in some areas, even though I get far more resolution and smoother frame rate on the Claw EX than the Xbox Ally X. Until a recent Intel update, Expedition 33 had what looked like intense graphical corruption around its particle effects in the game, turning them into glitchy spots of light. [Table: 720p benchmarks] And you should take Returnal benchmark numbers with a grain of salt, because many graphical effects are entirely missing on Intel. Undergrowth and volumetric fog are barely there; stone objects no longer explode into showers of rock; transparent energy shields are weirdly opaque. The second reason I reach for the Claw EX is that battery life. Like some of its competitors, it has a big 80 watt-hour pack — but the Intel chip can stretch that battery even further than the competition. Take Cyberpunk 2077, for example. chineseContent: 作为 The Verge 的常驻手持设备评测员，我家里的架子上几乎摆满了所有便携式游戏电脑。 MSI Claw 8 EX AI Plus 是我现在第一个接触到的。得益于下一代英特尔芯片和改进的 MSI 设计，Claw EX 是真正便携的最强大的手持设备。它是电池续航时间最长的手持设备，也是我可以信赖的第一款能够可靠地睡眠和唤醒的 Windows 手持设备。  就像 Steam Deck 一样，当我按下电源按钮时，我的游戏总是从我上次停下的地方开始。与 Steam Deck 不同的是，它可以休眠数天而不会损失大量电量。  性能和电池？开窗睡觉？我希望我能说“鱼与熊掌兼得”。但你不能。你可能不应该。你不能，因为这是 Ferris Bueller 产品评论 - 这款手持设备的售价高达 1,800 美元，即使以这个价格你也能找到它。 （MSI 的 Anne Lee 告诉我，美国本月某个时候应该限制供应。）即使可以，你也可能不应该这样做，因为英特尔、MSI 和微软没有完全坚持着陆。这确实是掌上游戏领域的一个里程碑。但就像高速公路上的实际里程碑一样，您可能应该直接开车过去。 [产品：MSI Claw 8 EX AI Plus | https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fclaw-8-ex-ai- cg3em-8-120hz-fhd-1200p-gaming-handheld-intel-arc-g3-extreme-intel-arc-32gb-1tbssd-console%2FJ3P7TXTKW3, https://go.skimresources.com/?id=1025X1701640&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bhphotovideo.com%2Fc%2Fproduct%2F1972338-REG%2Fmsi_claw_8_ex_ai_cg3em_024us_claw_8_ai_cg3em.html， https://click.linksynergy.com/deeplink?id=nOD/rLJHOac&mid=44583&murl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newegg.com%2Fp%2FN82E16868969012%3Fitem%3DN82E16868969012]
